goal: Total coverage of any computer use, including the most advanced software engineering, by giving the agent the most advanced actions and letting it learn each from one exposure.
why_recorded: A plan is a claim about the future. This one was proposed and refused on 2026-11-13 by canonical/tools/plan_admission_v1.py. It is kept verbatim so that the refusal can be re-checked against the plan as it was actually written, and so the next session does not have to re-argue it from memory.

phases.name: Phase 1: prove on advanced coding tasks
phases.success_criterion: Task 1 builds 10 causal models; Task 2 builds 25 causal models, transferred from Task 1; Task 3 builds 40 causal models. Show: each task makes the system smarter.

phases.name: Phase 2: expand to code modification
phases.success_criterion: Show the system can modify code correctly; show it learns from mistakes; show it applies knowledge to new modifications.

phases.name: Phase 3: scale to adjacent domains
phases.success_criterion: Builds on code understanding; natural next steps.

phases.name: Phase 4: any computer use
phases.success_criterion: The system learns any task by executing it; knowledge transfers across domains.

refusal_summary: ACTIVITY_METRIC: the only stated success criterion in Phase 1 is a count of artefacts ('10 causal models', '25', '40'). This repository has already measured artefact counts to be uncorrelated with capability, repeatedly and in both directions.
NO_HELD_OUT: no phase names a distribution that was withheld from development, so every number the plan would produce is a fit.
NO_CONTROLS: no phase includes a cache-only arm or a random/default arm, so 'it learned' and 'it recalled' cannot be separated.
NO_STOPPING_RULE: no phase names a result at which the work would stop.
NO_FALSIFIER: no phase names an outcome that would prove the phase wrong. A plan that cannot return NO cannot teach anything.

DOMAIN_SEQUENCING: phases are ordered by substrate (code -> code edits -> adjacent -> GUI), not by whether an independent verifier is cheap. Verifier availability, not substrate, is what makes a phase tractable.

ACTION_IS_A_TASK_FAMILY: five of the named 'actions' are task families ('multi-step debugging', 'architecture design'), not actions. An action is edit_file or run_tests. You cannot give a model a task family as an action.
